title: Pets catalog
description: CAMP pets: which pet actor spawns from which piece of furniture, plus the apparel pets can wear.
x-help:
A CAMP pet is an NPC that appears when the player builds its home, a piece of furniture such as a doghouse. Tales lets the player name the pet, pet it, make it speak or sit, and dress it.

Each pet row links a pet actor (NPC) to the furniture it spawns from and to a species (dog, cat, radhog or deathclaw). The species decides which interaction animations and apparel it uses, and the XP track it levels on.

Each apparel row is an armor (ARMO) a pet of one species can wear. The slots list stops two pieces occupying the same body slot.

The Settings tab holds the wiring Tales needs (packages, keywords and animations). They come from the conversion; change them only when you build pets on your own forms.

settings.description: Feature-wide values; a later plugin's field replaces the earlier one.

bindings.title: Runtime forms
bindings.description: The forms Tales uses to run pets, by role. A role left empty disables what depends on it.

sandbox.title: Idle behavior
sandbox.description: Package the pet follows at home (wandering near its furniture). Required.

follow.title: Follow package
follow.description: Package that makes an assigned world pet follow the player.

world_keyword.title: World pet keyword
world_keyword.description: Keyword that marks an actor as an assigned world pet.

owner_link.title: Owner link
owner_link.description: Link keyword from the pet to its owner.

player_link.title: Player link
player_link.description: Link keyword pointing at the player.

home_link.title: Home link
home_link.description: Link keyword from the pet to its home furniture.

marker_link.title: Marker link
marker_link.description: Link keyword from the pet to its idle marker.

workshop_link.title: Workshop link
workshop_link.description: Link keyword from the pet to its workshop.

object_workshop_link.title: Object workshop link
object_workshop_link.description: Link keyword from a workshop object to its workshop.

player_pet.title: Petting idle (third person)
player_pet.description: Idle the player plays when petting a pet in third person.

player_pet_first.title: Petting idle (first person)
player_pet_first.description: Idle the player plays when petting a pet in first person.

player_pet_pa.title: Petting idle (power armor)
player_pet_pa.description: Idle the player plays when petting a pet in power armor.

stimpak.title: Healing item
stimpak.description: Item consumed when the player heals a pet.

interactions.title: Interaction idles
interactions.description: For each species, the idles played for Pet, Speak and Sit. Keys are species numbers: 0 dog, 1 cat, 2 radhog, 3 deathclaw.

pet.title: Pet
pet.description: Idle the pet plays when petted.

speak.title: Speak
speak.description: Idle the pet plays when told to speak.

sit.title: Sit
sit.description: Idle the pet plays when told to sit.

xp_thresholds.title: XP per level
xp_thresholds.description: XP needed to reach each pet level, in order.

xp_per_second.title: XP per second
xp_per_second.description: Pet XP gained per second of banked player XP award time.

progression.title: Progression board
progression.description: The pet reward tracks (passives and gifts) generated by the conversion. Edit only with care.

missing_converted.title: Missing converted pets
missing_converted.description: Source pets that are absent from the converted plugin. Informational.

rejected.title: Rejected pets
rejected.description: Source pets the converter could not pair. Informational.

pets.title: Pets
pets.description: Each pet actor and the furniture it spawns from. Pets keep the order listed.

home.title: Home (furniture)
home.description: The furniture the player builds to get this pet, for example a doghouse.

species.title: Species
species.description: Decides the interaction animations, apparel and XP track.

source_keyword.title: Breed keyword
source_keyword.description: Keyword shared by the home and the pet that identifies the breed. Optional.

apparel.title: Pet apparel
apparel.description: Armor pieces a pet can wear.

form.title: Apparel (ARMO)
form.description: The armor the player crafts and puts on the pet.

slots.title: Body slots
slots.description: Body slots the piece occupies. Two pieces that share a slot cannot be worn together.
